title.narrative: Strengthening Institutions Towards the Implementation of Effective Anti-Corruption Programs

description.narrative: The main objective is to strengthen the capacities of institutions in developing anti-corruption programs that will demonstrate effectivenss in reducing corruption opportunities at the agency level. The tasks are: 1. Assessment of hte capacities of the PAGC and OMB in the implementation of the Integrity Development Action Plan and the Integrity Development Plan. 2. Review of the effectiveness of IDAP-IDR programs towards synchronization of activities, processes, monitoring and outcome. The output is to have a harmonized IDAP-IDR programs. 3. Improve or adjust the IDAP-IDR guidlines and processes through inclusion of anit-corruption practices that were successful or were proven effective in other countries or sectors. 4. Development of a monitoring tool or common scorecard at the agency level to monitor the effectiveness and impact of the DAP-IDR anit-corruption activities, which will include participation of civil society organizations. The main objective is to strengthen the capacities of anti-corruption institutions in implementation of integrity development programs towards reducing corruption opportunities and vulnerabilities at the agency level. For more than four years, two anti-corruption programs were being implemented in various agencies, including local government units, but the effectiveness of these programs have not been assessed or determined. The top management of the oversight bodies of these programs had decided to assess their programs to determine their effectiveness in reduing corruption opportunities and vulnerabilities at the agency level, prior to expanding their coverage widely to other agencies and LGUs.
